ratings_why.fun: Every turn is a real bank-or-keep-heating call, and the layout, sell and Konrad lines all feed one shared fuel, so I'd happily draft it.
ratings_why.distinct: Heat that is Attack only in fights, moved by front/back positions and melted from sales, plays unlike today's tribes, though 'pile counters, cash them in' is a familiar core.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; more passes would mostly reshuffle the same good web.

points.text: Guild Assayer refills any unit a Warden Quench or Grandmaster just emptied, if it sits later in reading order, and Nutrisco switches that off. Name this order trick in the builds; it is the best unlisted combo here.
Bellows Boy is still a fixed +1. Letting it pass its own Heat to the units it faces would add the one thing the tribe lacks: moving Heat between units on purpose.
Belly Grinder counts Heat, not Attack, so it pairs with keep-heating lines and ignores Mother Atra's buff. That split is good; a line in the builds would show it.
Konrad returning Quench-Bucket Runner with Nutrisco out is a Quench-every-turn engine; a second Forge When played worth repeating at Tier 4 or 5 would widen the Konrad line beyond the Bucket.

standouts.why: Nutrisco bends the core rule so Quenching stops spending fuel, which reroutes every other card.
Crested Konrad links hand, sale and When played lines, and works across tribes.
Ottilie's 4-Heat threshold makes exact Heat counts matter and fights over the same fuel as Quenching.

weakest.why: Bellows Boy is still a plain +1 Heat a turn; the row swap helps layout but adds no decision.
Smooth Tobias depends on random hits for a small gain and touches nothing else.
Wet Cellar Lurker asks you to leave slots empty, which costs tempo and hero damage for a few Heat.

flags.note: Golden Nutrisco with Grandmaster Quenches the same 10+ Heat every turn, and Paracel keeps raising it: a big high roll to watch in sims.
Crucible Keeper with Birds' Fly South turns a big Bird's Attack into Heat each turn and the Bird comes back.
Konrad repeats other tribes' When played every turn; check each once all tribes exist.
